scripts.draft: node scripts/sync.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts Incorpr out/draft.mp4 --scale 0.5 --crf 24 --concurrency 8
scripts.render: node scripts/sync.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts Incorpr out/incorpr-demo-raw.mp4 --image-format jpeg --jpeg-quality 95 --codec h264 --crf 16 --x264-preset medium --pixel-format yuv420p --audio-codec aac --audio-bitrate 320k
scripts.poster: node scripts/sync.mjs && remotion still src/index.ts Poster out/incorpr-thumbnail.png
scripts.banner: node scripts/sync.mjs && remotion still src/index.ts Banner out/incorpr-x-header.png
